alters.name: Lumen
alters.desc: First to stand between you and the world. Steady, warm, tired.

alters.name: Wren
alters.desc: Hums songs no one taught them. Soothes the others when nights are long.

alters.name: Sol
alters.desc: Knows the right words. Steps forward so you don't have to.

alters.name: Echo
alters.desc: Small and bright. Holds the playfulness the others had to set down.

alters.name: Vesper
alters.desc: Arrived when courage alone wasn't enough. Fierce, watchful, loyal.

alters.name: Iris
alters.desc: Turns the hard parts into colour. Sees doors where others see walls.
